Sri Kodandarama Temple Kurabalakota
description: Sri Kodandarama Swamy Temple is an ancient and historical Hindu temple located in Kurabalakota town, near Madanapalle (Annamayya district). Known for its traditional architecture, Sri Rama Navami celebrations, and annual Kalyanotsavam.
